Beveiliging waarbij alle meldingen via de MiApp kenbaar worden gemaakt en u zelf actie neemt voor het opsporen ervan. De meest recente positie en afgelegde route is online en op de MiApp direct zichtbaar. Speciaal geschikt voor het beveiligen van oldtimers, Youngtimers en werkmateriaal.

Compleet pakket met SCM gecertificeerde beveiliging incl. hulp na diefstal en KIWA SCM Certificaat voor uw verzekeraar. U wordt direct gewaarschuwd bij sabotage. het moedwillig verstoren van het signaal en er wordt alle mogelijke assistentie verleend bij de opsporing door de alarmcentrale.

Met het MiGreen pakket heeft u alle tools paraat om uw wagenpark zo efficient mogelijk te beheren. Fiscusproof rittenadministratie met keurmerk. Altijd inzicht in de locatie van uw voertuig(en) en alle mogelijkheden om gereden en gewerkte tijden inzichtelijk te maken.
Mini volgsysteem waarmee bij beweging online en via de MiApp de meest actuele positie continu zichtbaar is. Speciaal geschikt voor trailers en aanhangers.

Met het MIRed pakket heeft u de beschikking over een compleet inzicht in de gereden ritten van uw voertuig. Uw rittenadministratie is met dit pakket eenvoudig bij te houden en tevens heeft u op elk moment van de dag inzicht in de meest recente positie van uw voertuig(en).

Door activatie van uw peilzender is de alarmcentrale in staat de peilzender wanneer nodig in diefstalmodus te zetten. Ook wordt er minimaal eenmaal per dag een controlebericht verstuurd, waarmee de locatie van de peilzender op dat moment bepaald wordt.

All prices plus VAT. Invoices are due immediately and payable without deduction, but at least within 14 days of receipt of the invoice. The total amount for the services ordered under item 1 is payable half upon delivery and half 14 days after delivery - for the first order, the full amount is payable before delivery. Fees for services under item 2 are payable monthly in advance. If payment is delayed for more than 10 days, the contractor is entitled to stop the services without prior notice. For orders of more than EUR 2,500 net, payment of the initial invoice is only possible by bank transfer. The monthly hosting costs will then be collected by SEPA direct debit, if agreed. Support is provided via the service area in the TrackPilot portal. Questions and technical concerns are entered by the user and recorded as service tickets in the system. Tickets are processed from Monday to Friday between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. with a response time of usually less than 6 hours. This service is included in the monthly usage fee. Special technical support and individual consulting services (e.g. integration of third-party software, individual interface support, communication with the client's service providers or data protection inquiries) that go beyond the regular user support mentioned above will be invoiced at an hourly rate of €130 plus VAT. The smallest billing unit is 30 minutes in each case.

For all additional services that are associated with travel, travel and incidental costs as well as expenses and overnight stays will be invoiced according to actual costs. Travel times will be invoiced at €49 per hour; kilometers traveled by car will be invoiced at an additional €0.59 per km (basis: fastest route according to Google Maps). The choice of means of transport and overnight stay can be agreed with the client in advance.

With automated trip registration you save time and money. Do you also want to be able to make operational decisions quickly because you always know where your cars are? Then choose our All-in-one package. This gives you 24/7 insight into every movement of your drivers. From hours worked to locations visited and from maximum speeds to routes driven; you will never lose control again.

To prevent unjustified additional assessment, you must prove that you do not drive more than 500 kilometers privately with your company car. The Tax Authorities set high requirements for the way in which you register the kilometers driven. For you, this often means time-consuming and error-prone administration with the risk of fines and additional assessment. We are happy to take that off your hands with our Fiscal package.

In order to deploy your fleet as efficiently as possible and to be able to respond quickly to changes or urgent orders, it is important to know where your vehicles are. With Live Tracking, that is no problem at all. Log in to the online platform or the app on your phone and you will immediately see the location, route and speed of each car. Quick insight means quick action. Quick action means satisfied customers.

Just like fines and additional tax, you would like to avoid discussions about hours worked. Furthermore, you would like to drive as economically and efficiently as possible. That is all a lot easier with insight into routes driven, average and maximum speed, hours spent, use of vehicles outside working hours and a conclusive journey registration. That is why you have 24/7 access to all your important data with our reports.
